description: This is a Makefile fragment used for building firmware images for specific devices (e.g., Senao and WatchGuard). It defines build procedures, image creation steps, and device-specific configurations related to firmware packaging and upgrades.

methods.name: Build/senao-tar-gz
methods.description: Build rule that creates a compressed firmware archive for Senao devices, incorporating size, checksum, and kernel/ root filesystem images.

methods.name: Build/watchguard-cksum
methods.description: Build rule that computes and appends the MD5 checksum for WatchGuard firmware files.

methods.name: Device/senao_loader_okli
methods.description: Device-specific configuration defining firmware image formats, kernel and rootfs parameters, and image creation steps for Senao loader device.
